name: 58201 · Grand Forks, ND
findings: ZIP 58201 (Grand Forks) has 175 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 58201 (Grand Forks) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
